[ASSISTANT_SAID] Improving your serve takes time and practice, but with some tweaks to your technique and mindset, you can enhance your consistency and power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips provided to improve serve:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Stance and Footwork: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, body facing the net, turn body to the right (for right-handers), load weight onto back foot, transfer weight onto front foot while tossing the ball.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Toss and Ball Position: Toss the ball 6-8 feet in the air, slightly in front and to the right (for right-handers), keep eyes on the ball throughout the toss and contact.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Racket Position and Angle: Hold racket with a continental grip, racket face perpendicular to the court at contact, experiment with racket angles for spin and pace.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Contact and Follow-Through: Make contact at the top of the toss, aim for a spot on the court, follow through with racket in front.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Core and Leg Drive: Engage core muscles, use legs to drive body upward and forward.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Practice with Purpose: Practice with specific goals, focus on one aspect at a time, record serving to analyze technique.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Mix Up Your Serves: Practice different types of serves (flat, slice, topspin), vary speeds and angles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Strengthen Your Shoulder and Core: Incorporate exercises like shoulder rotations, medicine ball tosses, and planks.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Mental Approach: Focus on process, visualize successful serves.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Get Feedback and Be Patient: Work with a coach for feedback, be patient with progress.
